notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Solar builds. Arctic Haze is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical and very loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For a roll to clear both group and tougher individual adds, and which also synergises with Solar builds, in the first trait perk column Incandescent spreads +30 Solar Scorch stacks within 4m on a red bar Minor add kill (+45 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars), with scorch damage counting as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and also proc subclass fragments. In the second column, you can use a scorch ability to make the most of Burning Ambition to build Solar ignitions on tougher targets. If you can't apply scorch first, it'll take ~28 hits within 2s of each other to apply +10 scorch stacks, with +10 added on each additional hit afterwards to build towards an ignition. All of the scorch stacks for both perks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. Aegis ranks the Winterized Gear origin trait as F-Tier for PvE - it provides ×3 stacks after 12s out of combat - each stack decays after 5s in combat providing a gradually reducing boost to Stability, Handling and Reload Speed. If you're interested, the name functions as a literal description of its frozen, storm-swept source world of Europa. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.
